changeSet.author: josh
changeSet.comment: Convert transaction.created_at from TIMESTAMP to TIMESTAMPTZ for OffsetDateTime (UTC) support. Aligns with transaction.updated_at and ensures cancellation threshold and reporting use UTC consistently.

changeSet.author: system
changeSet.comment: Convert transaction.requested_at from TIMESTAMP to TIMESTAMPTZ for OffsetDateTime (UTC) support. Aligns with created_at and updated_at.
